about_the_game:
The cosmos is in chaos—Starboi’s friends have been captured by unspeakable horrors from beyond the stars! Armed only with your wits and the raw power of starlight, you’ll launch yourself across the galaxy, dodging deadly black holes and blasting through tentacled monstrosities that block your path.

Every level pushes you further into the void, with new hazards, faster challenges, and relentless enemies standing between you and your friends. The further you travel, the more dangerous the universe becomes—black holes multiply, cosmic horrors grow stronger, and every tenth level brings you face-to-face with a massive tentacled boss determined to end your journey.

Unleash bursts of star power to burn through the darkness and fight back against the creatures of the void. Perfect your timing, sharpen your reflexes, and master the art of navigating a collapsing galaxy to survive the journey.

Can you overcome the endless black holes and save your friends from the cosmic horrors lurking in the dark?

Features:

  • Fast-paced arcade action with simple but challenging mechanics.

  • Shoot blasts of star power to fight back against cosmic tentacle monsters.

  • Increasing difficulty as new black holes and enemies spawn with every level.

  • Epic boss battles every 10 stages to test your skill and reflexes.

  • A journey across the galaxy fueled by determination, courage, and light.
